High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard and perused the record.

This is first bail application filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail on behalf of appellant in relation to F.I.R. No/Crime No.1724/2023,
registered at Police Station- Banganga, District-Indore (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 409, 419 of IPC and Section 66-D of IT Act.

2- The allegation against the applicant is that he is involved in the aforesaid offence wherein accused persons committed fraud by persuading the complainant over the mobile phone to invest in the share market on the promise of higher returns.

On the basis of false promise complainant invested Rahul Nagar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21344174/
1 Rs.50,000/- and lost the entire amount, thereafter when the complainant tried to contact the accused persons, they did not respond.

entities.text: Rahul Nagar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Further, allegation is that the complainant received calls from unknown numbers assuring him to compensate the loss if he invested more money in the market.
3- Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is alleged that on the behest of an anonymous telephone call the complainant has invested Rs.50,000/ and later on when he contacted the aforesaid number no one has responded to his call, thereafter complainant received a call from some unknown person who assured the complainant to compensate his loss if he would invest more money in the share market.

The applicant is made accused only on the basis of the statement of co-accused persons recorded under Section 27 of Evidence Act and apart that there is no other evidence available on record to implicate the applicant in the present crime.
Other co-accused persons have already been enlarged on bail by the trial Court itself.
The applicant is ready to co-operate with the investigation.
Hence, it has been prayed that the applicant be released on anticipatory bail.
4- Learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

5- Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case and that the applicant has been made accused on the basis of memo of co- accused persons, but without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which applicant may be released on anticipatory bail.
Consequently, this first application for anticipatory bail filed on behalf of the applicant is hereby allowed.

6 - It is directed that in the event of arrest applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Authority.
At the stage of filing of charge sheet by police, the applicant shall furnish fresh bail bond of the same amount before the committal Court/trial Court to its satisfaction.

The applicant shall comply with the following conditions:-
(i) that he/she shall make himself/herself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required.

(ii) that he/she shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.

(iii) the applicants shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in sub-Section (2) of Section 438 of Cr.P.C.
(iv) In case if the applicant is not arrested by the investigating officer, the applicant himself/herself shall surrender before the Investigating Officer within 15 days from today and will join the investigation.

sentences.text: (v) The applicant shall mark his presence before the investigating officer on every 2nd and 4th Sunday of every month between 10.00 am to 12.00 noon during the pendency of the trial.
Any default in marking presence in the concerned police station would result in cancellation of bail granted by this Court thereby entitling the police to take the applicant in custody immediately.
(7). However, it is being made clear that in case of bail jump and in violation of any of the conditions, this order shall become ineffective.
